procedures.title: Propeller shaft (Dana): remove, repair and install
steps: Removal: raise the car, mark how the shaft lines up with the companion flange, and remove the trunnion bearing U-bolts to free the rear U-joint (see figure 92 in the manual).
Tape the bearing cups to the trunnion so the cups and rollers are not lost.
On Corvettes, also remove the trunnion U-bolts at the transmission yoke.
Pull the front yoke out of the transmission by moving the shaft rearward under the axle; watch for oil leaking from the transmission output shaft housing.
notes: The U-joints (see figure 93 in the manual) are extended-life and need no routine inspection or lubrication, but whenever one is taken apart, repack the bearings, fill the trunnion end reservoirs with high-melting-point wheel bearing grease and fit new dust seals.
